name: Maksym Kacper Horoszczak
title: Mechanical Engineering Undergraduate

education.degree: Bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering | Third year

projects.name: Custom 5-inch FPV drone
projects.label: Designed, built and flown
bullets: Designed a dead-cat carbon-fibre frame in SolidWorks for agile flight and a forward-mounted camera. Prepared DXF cutting files and arranged manufacture.
Balanced the camera payload with rear battery placement, considering the centres of gravity and thrust. Designed component mounts and cut-outs to reduce frame material.
Assembled the drone, soldered its electronics and completed initial flights.

projects.name: Lychee and Absorb
projects.label: Published iOS apps
bullets: Built and released Lychee, a food and cosmetics barcode scanner with product scoring, and Absorb, a word-by-word RSVP reading app.
Manage product development, releases and distribution, with promotion currently focused on Lychee.
